title: CPF Module Schema: Event Hub module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-eventhub'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

authorization_rules.type: map(object({ name = string listen = optional(bool, false) send = optional(bool, false) manage = optional(bool, false) }))
authorization_rules.description: (Optional) An Event Hub Namespace Authorization Rules configuation as defined below.. object({ name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the Authorization Rule." listen = "(Optional) Grants listen access to this this Authorization Rule." send = "(Optional) Grants send access to this this Authorization Rule." manage = "(Optional) Grants manage access to this this Authorization Rule. When this property is true - both listen and send must be too." })

capture_description.type: object({ enabled = bool encoding = string interval_in_seconds = optional(number, 300) size_limit_in_bytes = optional(number, 314572800) skip_empty_archives = optional(bool, false) destination = object({ name = string archive_name_format = string blob_container_name = string storage_account_id = string }) })
capture_description.description: (Optional) A capture_description block as defined below. object({ enabled = "(Required) Specifies if the Capture Description is Enabled." encoding = "(Required) Specifies the Encoding used for the Capture Description. Possible values are `Avro` and `AvroDeflate`." interval_in_seconds = "(Optional) Specifies the time interval in seconds at which the capture will happen. Values can be between 60 and 900 seconds." size_limit_in_bytes = "(Optional) Specifies the amount of data built up in your EventHub before a Capture Operation occurs. Value should be between 10485760 and 524288000 bytes." skip_empty_archives = "(Optional) Specifies if empty files should not be emitted if no events occur during the Capture time window." destination = (Required) A destination block as defined below. object({ name = "(Required) The Name of the Destination where the capture should take place. At this time the only supported value is `EventHubArchive.AzureBlockBlob`." archive_name_format = "(Required) The Blob naming convention for archiving. e.g. {Namespace}/{EventHub}/{PartitionId}/{Year}/{Month}/{Day}/{Hour}/{Minute}/{Second}." blob_container_name = "(Required) The name of the Container within the Blob Storage Account where messages should be archived." storage_account_id = "(Required) The ID of the Blob Storage Account where messages should be archived." }) })

consumer_groups.type: map(object({ name = string user_metadata = optional(string, null) }))
consumer_groups.description: (Optional) An Event Hub Consumer Group objects as defined below.. object({ name = "(Required) Specifies the name of the EventHub Consumer Group resource." user_metadata = "(Optional) Specifies the user metadata." })

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

eventhub_name.description: (Optional) Specifies the custom name of the EventHub. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

eventhub_namespace_name.description: (Required) Specifies the name of the EventHub Namespace. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

message_retention.description: (Required) Specifies the number of days to retain the events for this Event Hub.

partition_count.description: (Required) Specifies the current number of shards on the Event Hub. Changing this will force-recreate the resource.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the resource.

status.description: (Optional) Specifies the status of the Event Hub resource. Possible values are `Active`, `Disabled` and `SendDisabled`.

consumer_group_ids.description: The IDs of the Event Hub consumer groups.

consumer_group_names.description: The names of the Event Hub consumer groups.

id.description: The ID of the created Event Hub.

name.description: The name of the created Event Hub.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Eventhub' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
